stories.name_fr: Production issue des hubs de centres de données visée à 2035
stories.name_en: New generation from data center hubs by 2035
stories.explanation: Cas de base ; un cas haut vise environ 30 GW.
stories.story_fr: NextEra Energy prévoit au moins 15 GW de nouvelle production issue de hubs de centres de données d’ici 2035.
stories.story_en: NextEra Energy expects data center hubs to contribute at least 15 GW of new generation by 2035.
stories.citation: Data center hubs are expected to contribute at least 15 GW of new generation by 2035

stories.name_fr: Nombre de hubs potentiels visé fin 2026
stories.name_en: Potential data center hubs targeted by end of 2026
stories.story_fr: NextEra Energy a déjà identifié plus de 20 hubs potentiels et attend de porter ce nombre à plus de 40 d’ici fin 2026.
stories.story_en: NextEra Energy has identified 20+ potential hubs and expects to grow its opportunity set to over 40 by the end of 2026.
stories.citation: We have already identified 20+ potential hubs and expect to grow our opportunity set to over 40 by the end of 2026

stories.name_fr: Croissance annuelle visée du BPA ajusté jusqu’en 2032
stories.story_fr: NextEra Energy attend une croissance annuelle composée d’au moins 8 % de son bénéfice ajusté par action jusqu’en 2032, à partir de la base 2025.
stories.story_en: NextEra Energy expects adjusted EPS to grow at a compound annual rate of 8%+ through 2032 off the 2025 base.
stories.citation: Expect 8%+ compounded annual growth rate through 2032 off the 2025 adjusted EPS expectations range

stories.name_fr: Croissance annuelle visée du dividende par action
stories.story_fr: NextEra Energy attend une croissance annuelle composée de 6 % de son dividende par action à partir du montant 2026.
stories.story_en: NextEra Energy expects a 6% compound annual growth rate in dividend per share off the 2026 amount.
stories.citation: Expect 6% CAGR off the 2026 dividend amount

stories.name_fr: Carnet de renouvelables et de stockage
stories.story_fr: Le carnet de projets renouvelables et de stockage de NextEra Energy atteint environ 30 GW.
stories.story_en: NextEra Energy has about 30 GW of renewables and storage backlog.

stories.name_fr: Capacité nouvelle pouvant être développée jusqu’en 2032
stories.explanation: Programme de développement de NextEra Energy Resources.
stories.story_fr: NextEra Energy Resources estime pouvoir développer de 77 à 108 GW de nouvelle production d’ici 2032.
stories.story_en: Energy Resources believes it has the opportunity to develop about 77 to 108 GW of new generation through 2032.
stories.citation: Energy Resources believes it has the opportunity to develop ~77 to ~108 GW of new generation through 2032

stories.story_fr: NextEra Energy a construit 33 GW d’infrastructures de production entre 2020 et 2024.
stories.story_en: NextEra Energy has built 33 GW of power infrastructure over 2020 to 2024.
stories.citation: NextEra Energy has built 33 GW of power infrastructure
